binding_rules: Every factual value in a projection output must resolve through a binding_id present in the bindings dict.

A factual field with no valid binding degrades honestly to {"value": null, "status": "UNBOUND", "claim_class": "UNKNOWN"} with a machine-readable reason (BINDING_NOT_FOUND, BINDING_MALFORMED, OBJECT_ID_MISMATCH, FIELD_PATH_NOT_FOUND). The gap is shown, never filled with an invented fact.
A binding is {"object_id", "field_path", "evidence_refs", "claim_class"}. The value is read from the business object at field_path; the claim_class is preserved verbatim from the binding.
Generated copy sections always carry claim_class GENERATED_SUMMARY. Copy is templated deterministically from bound values only.
Claim classes are never flattened to a confidence number.
GENERATE != PUBLISH: compiling a projection does not publish it. Publication requires a proposed canonical object transition.

formats.name: EXPLANATION
formats.output_contract: Header (format, projection_kind DERIVED, canonical false, source_object_id, generate_note) plus bound factual nodes: subject, definition, benefits (one node per list item), audience_fit; and generated-copy sections labeled GENERATED_SUMMARY.
formats.purpose: Plain-language explanation of what the business's service is, what it does, and who it suits.
formats.when_to_use: When a reader needs a first, jargon-free understanding of a service before any detail, comparison, or how-to.

input_contract.note: Each entry in comparison names its own ours_binding and alt_binding; rows sort deterministically by attribute name.

formats.name: COMPARISON
formats.output_contract: Header plus bound subject node and rows of {attribute label, ours node, alternative node, alternative label}; generated-copy sections note that no ranking is implied.
formats.purpose: Side-by-side comparison of the service against an alternative across named attributes.
formats.when_to_use: When a reader is choosing between options and needs attribute-level facts without a ranking or recommendation.

input_contract.note: Each milestone entry names its own label_binding and date_binding; events sort deterministically by bound date then label.

formats.name: TIMELINE
formats.output_contract: Header plus bound subject node and ordered events of {label node, date node}; one generated-copy intro section.
formats.purpose: Milestones of the service engagement in chronological order.
formats.when_to_use: When a reader needs to know what happens when: the sequence of events from first contact to completion.

input_contract.note: Each step names its own title_binding and detail_binding plus an integer order; nodes re-index deterministically after sorting.

formats.name: PROCESS DIAGRAM
formats.output_contract: Header plus bound subject node, nodes of {index, order, title node, detail node}, and sequence edges {from, to, kind}; one generated-copy intro section.
formats.purpose: Ordered process steps as nodes with sequence edges: how the work flows.
formats.when_to_use: When a reader needs the operational shape of a service: steps, order, and what each step involves.

input_contract.note: Each faq entry carries curator-written question text (labeled GENERATED_SUMMARY) and an answer_binding.

formats.name: FAQ
formats.output_contract: Header plus bound subject node and entries of {question (generated copy), answer (bound node)}; one generated-copy intro section.
formats.purpose: Frequently asked questions with answers bound to business evidence.
formats.when_to_use: When readers arrive with specific questions and each answer must stay traceable to its evidence.

input_contract.note: Each step carries curator-written instruction text (labeled GENERATED_SUMMARY) and an evidence_binding resolving to a bound node.

formats.name: TUTORIAL
formats.output_contract: Header plus bound subject node and steps of {step_number, instruction (generated copy), evidence (bound node)}; one generated-copy intro section.
formats.purpose: Numbered how-to instructions, each tied to the evidence it rests on.
formats.when_to_use: When a reader must do something correctly step by step, with every step traceable to a source.

input_contract.note: Each concept names its own concept_binding; each relation names from_binding, to_binding, and curator-written relation text (labeled GENERATED_SUMMARY).

formats.name: CONCEPT MAP
formats.output_contract: Header plus bound subject node, nodes of {id, label node} sorted deterministically, and edges of {from, to, from_label node, to_label node, relation (generated copy)}; one generated-copy intro section.
formats.purpose: Concepts as nodes and their relations as labeled edges: how ideas connect.
formats.when_to_use: When a reader needs the mental model: the key terms and how they relate to each other.

source_directive: 2026-10-04 projection-plane directive, section EDUCATION IS ANOTHER PROJECTION
status: DERIVED projection machinery. Not canonical, not an authority, never publishes.
